acceptanceCriteria: A sandbox launcher failure is surfaced as a distinct bounded reason without echoing repository-controlled output.
A test covers the launcher-failure classification.
Existing not-run and downgrade semantics are unchanged for other causes.
body:
Friction observed 2026-10-01. Inside an outer macOS sandbox (Codex CLI workspace-write), TestDiscriminateRecordsWitnessAndReportDowngrades in internal/cem/workflow fails with discriminates=0 notRun=2 (want 1/1). The witness detail is only 'mutation runner failed for pkg/calc/calc_test.go: mutate: run ended without a verdict'. Temporary instrumentation in a scratch copy of internal/liveverify/mutate/gotest.go (inconclusive) showed the hidden cause: 'sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply: Operation not permitted'. Outside the outer sandbox the test passes 5/5 on a clean checkout and on the overlay.

Expected: an environment that cannot apply the nested sandbox is reported with a bounded, non-repository-controlled reason (for example a distinct sandbox-unavailable code) so it is distinguishable from a broken run. Actual: the reason is discarded; diagnosis needed source instrumentation. The discard is deliberate to avoid exposing repository-controlled test output, so the fix must classify the launcher failure without echoing test output.
title: Mutation runner hides why a run ended without a verdict (nested sandbox-exec denial)
